text:
Alex Morgan: Morning — quick digest from my side. Ran the nightly vuln scan and the infra scanner flagged 3 medium creds findings in the staging KMS access policy. PRs incoming.
sec-bot: automated-scan results: 3 findings — IDs sv-1023, sv-1024, sv-1025. Link: https://ci/redwood/scans/179765
Nina Patel: looking now. sv-1023 looks like an expired IAM binding on a service account used by batch jobs.
Ryan Chen: can you drop the exact SA? I can take sv-1024 (role escalation path) — pinging in a sec.
Alex Morgan: SA is svc-batch@redwood-internal. sv-1024 is a policy that allows cross-account assumeRole, probably a stale dev role.
Megan Ortiz: I posted a small PR to remove the stale binding: #2847 — needs review from @ryan and @nina. Short description in PR.
Ryan Chen: reviewing #2847 now. Will comment before EOD. If it looks good I can merge and trigger a rotation.
Nina Patel: I can follow with a KMS rotation dry-run. Plan: rotate key `projects/rw-prod/kms/keys/ingest` in staging first. Command I used: 
```
$ rwd-kms rotate --key ingest --env staging --dry-run
```
Alex Morgan: nice. After merge let's run the dry-run then schedule a real rotation in a maintenance window.
Carol Li: compliance note — update to change log required for rotation and PR reference. I'll add entries to the SOC docs once PR is merged.
Megan Ortiz: small blocker: the canary job fails intermittently after PR merge on staging, not sure if related to SA change. @alex can you check the canary logs?
Alex Morgan: checking -- saw `permission denied` for svc-batch on /ingest/topic. Might be propagation lag. Will re-run queue permissions script.
Ryan Chen: if it's a propagation lag we should add a traffic-safe rollback plan. I'll add a fallback to rebind the previous role automatically for 15 min if errors spike.
sec-bot: deploy-bot: canary redeploy scheduled at 09:30 UTC (id: deploy-2026-03-17-0915)
Nina Patel: FYI I'll coordinate the real rotation after we verify canary for 30m. ETA: lunchtime window 12:30-13:00 if all green.
Carol Li: ok — compliance happy with that window. Please capture the verification steps for audit.
Megan Ortiz: thx all — I'll mark the PR with required reviews and retest the canary after your redeploy @alex.
Alex Morgan: updated canary run — logs show transient denial, now fixed. :thumbsup:
Ryan Chen: merged #2847 at 10:05 UTC. KMS dry-run next.
Nina Patel: dry-run completed, no data loss, rotation plan looks good. I'll post the final rotation steps and runbook here before actual rotation.
Megan Ortiz: great. Anything else? quick security FYI: dependency lib-crypto 2.4.1 has a minor advisory, opened #2850 to bump to 2.4.2.
Alex Morgan: noted. If it's non-blocking we can queue it post-rotation. Thanks everyone.
Carol Li: I'll close the audit ticket once rotations are done and docs updated.
Ryan Chen: done for me.
sec-bot: Reminder: weekly compliance snapshot at 18:00 UTC — will collect rotation events automatically.
Alex Morgan: cool — end of digest. ping if any regressions.
